caveats.text: Crash counts are raw, not normalized by ridership (no public cyclist-volume data is joined yet), so busy corridors look worse than dangerous quiet ones.
Recent months are provisional — crash records get amended upstream, so the most recent 1-2 months of any trend may still move.
Dooring crashes are structurally undercounted in police crash reports (see the dooring-undercount finding).

Never present mock-tier data as real.

note: crash_id is a 16-hex-char prefix of the full crash_id (full ids and the full field set are in site/data/crashes_cyclist.geojson, linked via full_data_url); lat/lng are rounded to 5 decimal places. Dropped columns crash_type, lighting, and segment_id are available in the full GeoJSON.
